passive.name: Hextech Munitions
passive.description: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus true damage.

primaryAbilities.name: Phosphorus Bomb
primaryAbilities.description: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Corki lobs a bomb, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The area and champions hit are revealed for {{ revealduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Valkyrie
primaryAbilities.description: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Corki flies over and scorches a path, burning it for {{ trailduration }} seconds. Enemies in the fire take up to <magicDamage>{{ maximumdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over the duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Gatling Gun
primaryAbilities.description: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Corki fires a gatling gun in front of him, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> over {{ sprayduration }} seconds and shredding up to <scaleArmor>{{ shredmax*-1 }} Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Missile Barrage
primaryAbilities.description: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Corki fires a missile that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing {{ rsmallmissiledamage }} physical damage to surrounding enemies. Every third missile instead deals {{ rbigmissiledamage }} physical damage.

This Ability has up to {{ maxammotooltip }} charges. Basic attacks against champions reduce the time between charges by {{ attackrefund }} seconds on hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
